Definition: from G1199; to tie, i.e. shackle:--bind.
BiblicalUsage: This verb means to tie or shackle, and it stands in the King James text at the verse where the demon-possessed man is kept bound with chains and fetters. The Greek text most modern Bibles follow spells the same verb with a different ending and lists it under a neighbouring word, so the verse is cited here as the Received Text reading.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the chains in this verse are the picture of a man no one could bind; men bound him and he broke the bands, and only Christ could loose him, which is the point the verse is making.
